en: a senior official who represents his or her country in a foreign country; someone who represents or promotes an organization or activity
ex: The ambassador met with the president to discuss the trade agreement.
大使與總統會面討論貿易協定。

en: a. having or showing the ability to learn, understand and think about things quickly and well; (of a machine or system) able to react to its surroundings; understanding
ex: She is an intelligent girl who always gets top marks.
她是個聰明的女孩，總是拿高分。

en: v. to respect and approve of someone or something; to look at something with pleasure and appreciation; to praise someone
ex: I really admire her courage and determination.
我真的很欽佩她的勇氣與決心。

en: n. an amount of money; the total you get when you add numbers together; the main point of something; v. to add numbers together; to give a short summary of something
ex: The total sum of the bill was five hundred dollars.
帳單總額是五百美元。

en: n. the skin of a fruit or vegetable; v. to remove the skin from fruit or vegetables; (of skin or paint) to come off in small pieces; to take off clothes
ex: Peel the potatoes before you boil them.
煮馬鈴薯前先削皮。

en: a school for very young children, usually aged four to six, where they play and begin to learn
ex: My daughter started kindergarten last September.
我女兒去年九月開始上幼稚園。

en: n. a solid substance made by bees or from petroleum, used for candles and polish; v. to put wax on something to make it shiny; (of the moon) to appear gradually larger; to become
ex: She used wax to polish the wooden floor.
她用蠟擦亮木地板。

en: n. a feeling of great sadness because of something that has happened, especially the death of someone; something that causes great sadness; v. to feel or express great sadness
ex: She was overcome with sorrow when she heard the sad news.
她聽到噩耗時悲痛欲絕。
ph: more in sorrow than in anger
與其說憤怒不如說悲傷

en: n. the general direction in which something is changing or developing; a fashion; v. to change or develop in a particular direction
ex: There is a growing trend toward working from home.
在家工作的趨勢愈來愈明顯。

en: n. a program on television or radio; the act of sending out programs; v. to send out a program on television or radio; to tell something to many people; a. sent by radio or TV
ex: The match will be broadcast live on television tonight.
這場比賽今晚將在電視上直播。

en: a. relating to real situations and actions rather than ideas; likely to be successful or useful; good at doing things that are useful in daily life
ex: She gave me some practical advice on how to save money.
她給了我一些實用的省錢建議。

en: a. ready or happy to do something if asked; doing something because you want to, not because you are forced; (of help) given freely
ex: I'm willing to help you with your homework.
我願意幫你寫作業。

en: n. the activity of buying and selling goods or services; a particular kind of business; a job that needs special skills; v. to buy and sell goods; to exchange one thing for another
ex: Trade between the two countries has increased in recent years.
近年來兩國之間的貿易有所增加。

en: n. a set of keys on a computer or typewriter; a musical instrument with keys like a piano
ex: He typed the report on his laptop keyboard.
他在筆電鍵盤上打報告。

en: n. an amount of money given to a student to pay for their education; the quality of serious academic study; a person's learning and knowledge
ex: She won a scholarship to study in the United States.
她拿到獎學金去美國留學。

en: n. a yellow metal made from copper and zinc; musical instruments made from this metal; (informal) a lot of money; (informal) a cheeky or bold attitude; a. made of brass
ex: The door handle is made of polished brass.
門把是拋光黃銅做的。

en: to take the place of something; to put something back where it was before; to change something for something new or better
ex: Please replace the batteries when the light turns red.
燈變紅時請更換電池。

en: adv. on or into a ship, plane, train or other vehicle; prep. on or into a ship, plane or train; included in a team or project
ex: All passengers are now aboard the ship.
所有乘客現在都已上船了。

en: n. a piece of clothing without sleeves worn over a shirt; (US) a waistcoat; (BrE) an undershirt; v. to give someone power or authority; to put into the possession of someone
ex: He wore a gray vest over his white shirt.
他在白襯衫外面穿了一件灰色背心。

en: a. happening or done most often; the same as at other times; (as usual) in the normal way
ex: He arrived at the office earlier than usual.
他比平常更早到辦公室。

en: a. giving pleasure or enjoyment; pleasant and fun
ex: We had a very enjoyable evening at the concert.
我們在音樂會度過了非常愉快的一晚。

en: a person who uses violence and threats to frighten people or governments in order to achieve political goals
ex: The police arrested a suspected terrorist at the airport.
警方在機場逮捕了一名疑似恐怖分子。

en: n. a light strong material made from chemicals, used to make many objects; a credit card; a. made of plastic; (of a substance) easily shaped or molded; artificial
ex: Many toys are made of plastic.
許多玩具是塑膠做的。

en: n. a white or brown powder made from grain and used to make bread, cakes and pasta; v. to cover something with flour
ex: Mix the flour and sugar together in a large bowl.
把麵粉和糖在大碗裡混合均勻。

en: n. physical or mental damage or injury; v. to hurt or damage someone or something
ex: Smoking can do serious harm to your health.
吸菸會對你的健康造成嚴重傷害。

en: prep. in or to a lower position than something; below something; not good enough for someone; adv. in or to a lower position
ex: The cat is sleeping beneath the table.
貓正在桌子底下睡覺。

en: n. a thick liquid served with food to give it more flavor; (informal) rude talk; v. to add flavor to food; to make something more interesting
ex: I like to put hot sauce on my noodles.
我喜歡在麵上加辣醬。

en: n. a hot-tasting powder made from dried berries that is used to flavor food; a hollow green, red or yellow vegetable; v. to put pepper on food; to hit with many small things
ex: Add a little salt and pepper to the soup.
在湯裡加一點鹽和胡椒。

en: v. to see or notice something; to watch someone or something carefully; to obey a law or rule; to celebrate a special day; to say or write something about what you have seen
ex: Scientists observe the behavior of animals in the wild.
科學家觀察野生動物的行為。

en: n. a machine that records sound; a person who keeps official records; a simple musical instrument like a flute that you blow into; a judge in some courts
ex: The teacher asked us to bring a recorder to music class.
老師要我們帶直笛來上音樂課。

en: v. to become less or to make something less in size, number or amount; n. the process of becoming less; the amount by which something becomes less
ex: The number of accidents has decreased in recent years.
近年來事故數量已經減少。

en: pron. used as the object of a verb or preposition to ask or give information about which person; (formal) the objective case of 'who'
ex: To whom should I address the letter?
這封信應該寄給誰？

en: n. a flat object with raised edges used for carrying food or drinks; a flat open container for papers in an office
ex: The waiter carried a tray of drinks to the table.
服務生端著一盤飲料走到桌邊。

en: a drink made from lemon juice, sugar and water; (BrE) a clear sweet fizzy drink
ex: We sat in the garden and drank cold lemonade.
我們坐在花園裡喝冰檸檬汁。

en: v. to change or be different depending on the situation; to make something different; to be different from each other
ex: Prices vary from store to store.
價格因店而異。

en: n. a small soft round fruit without a stone that grows on a bush; v. to pick berries
ex: We picked fresh berries in the garden for breakfast.
我們在花園裡摘了新鮮的莓果當早餐。

en: a. correct and true in every detail; able to give exactly the right result
ex: The report must be accurate and up to date.
報告必須準確且是最新的。

en: n. a round white, red or yellow vegetable with a strong smell and taste that makes your eyes water when you cut it
ex: She chopped an onion and fried it in oil.
她切了一顆洋蔥用油炒。

en: n. the time of day when light first appears in the sky; the beginning of a period or idea; v. (of day) to begin; to become clear to someone
ex: We got up at dawn to watch the sun rise.
我們黎明就起床看日出。

en: n. money that is made in business or by selling something; an advantage or benefit; v. to be useful to someone; to make money; to gain an advantage
ex: The company made a large profit last year.
公司去年賺了一大筆利潤。
